title: Maximize WiFi throughput on LTSC laptop (WiFi-only)
symptom: WiFi link at expected rate but want lowest latency and max real throughput: default adapter power saving, auto band, default ISP DNS, and QoS reservation waste performance.

affected.condition: Laptop with Intel WiFi 6 (e.g. AX203), 5GHz, no Ethernet

root_cause: Out-of-the-box the WiFi adapter uses Auto SMPS (MIMO power save), medium roaming, no 5GHz preference, and default ISP DNS; Windows also reserves 20% bandwidth for QoS and enables Nagle's algorithm (adds ACK delay). These add latency and reduce effective throughput.
plain_language: La tarjeta WiFi y la pila de red de Windows vienen con ajustes conservadores (ahorro de energía, banda automática, DNS del proveedor, reserva de ancho de banda). Para una laptop solo-WiFi esto añade latencia. El script pone la tarjeta en modo de máximo rendimiento, usa DNS rápido (Cloudflare) y quita la reserva de QoS. Mejora la velocidad real y la latencia sin tocar tu navegación.
undo: Set Preferred Band back to 1. No Preference, MIMO Power Save to Auto SMPS, Roaming to 3. Medium, DNS back to DHCP, restore QoS/Nagle registry values, re-enable NDU (Start=2).
author: @opencode-session
